scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run types && npm run py
scripts.types: python tools/check_baseline.py tsc -- npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.types:update: python tools/check_baseline.py tsc --update -- npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.py: python tools/check_baseline.py ruff -- python -m ruff check --output-format json . && python tools/check_baseline.py mypy -- python -m mypy build_tiles.py tests tools
scripts.py:update: python tools/check_baseline.py ruff --update -- python -m ruff check --output-format json . && python tools/check_baseline.py mypy --update -- python -m mypy build_tiles.py tests tools
